column1: # hearth's built-in user pictures. scripts/build-avatars.sh turns this into
# kind fluent:   Microsoft Fluent Emoji 3D (MIT), source = asset folder name,
#                composed on a soft gradient tile (bg=#top,#bottom overrides
#                the colour picked from the emoji; size = emoji share of the tile).
# kind commons:  a Wikimedia Commons file by page id; the build refuses
#                anything whose licence isn't CC0 or public domain.
#                x/y = crop centre (0..1), zoom = crop tighter than the short side.
# kind gradient: generated here, source = colours (soft blobs on the first).
